title: Multi-agent System for Automatic Discovery of Pareto-optimal Meta-solvers for PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.31611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing linear solvers for discretized partial differential equations requires problem-specific expertise. We present a multi-agent framework, in which language-model agents propose, critique, implement, and evaluate solver configurations assembled from Krylov methods, preconditioners, block factorizations, and neural operators. Inside the proposing agent, a non-dominated sorting genetic evolutionary algorithm evolves the population of meta-solvers toward the Pareto front of six measured quantities, so that one run returns a front of trade-offs rather than a single tuned solver. The system runs on small open-weight language models served on a single laptop, and we compare it with a single agent on four problems. For three-dimensional acoustic scattering and elasticity, it delivers 47 and 48 convergent hybrid solvers out of 60 candidates. translated_title: 用于自动发现偏微分方程帕累托最优元求解器的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 为离散化偏微分方程设计线性求解器需要针对具体问题的专业知识。我们提出了一个多智能体框架，其中语言模型智能体负责提出、批判、实现和评估由Krylov方法、预条件子、块分解和神经算子组装而成的求解器配置。在提出智能体内部，一种非支配排序遗传进化算法使元求解器种群朝着六项测量指标的帕累托前沿演化，从而单次运行即可返回一组权衡方案，而非单一调优后的求解器。该系统运行于单台笔记本电脑上的小型开源权重语言模型，并在四个问题上与单智能体系统进行了比较。对于三维声散射和弹性问题，它在60个候选方案中分别获得了47个和48个收敛的混合求解器。相对于采用Jacobi预条件的Krylov基线，所发现的最优求解器将求解时间……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种多智能体框架，让语言模型智能体与非支配排序遗传进化算法相结合，自动演化出针对偏微分方程的帕累托最优混合求解器，仅需单次运行即可在小模型上产生一组求解器权衡方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework where language-model agents and a non-dominated sorting genetic evolutionary algorithm automatically evolve Pareto-optimal hybrid meta-solvers for PDEs, returning a front of trade-off solutions in a single run on small open-weight language models.
